entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Author: M.Satyanarayana Murthy
Bench: M.Satyanarayana Murthy
 The Hon'Ble Sri Justice M.Satyanarayana Murthy
 Criminal Petition No.4047 Of 2020
Order:

This criminal petition is filed by the petitioners/Accused under Section 482 of Criminal Procedure Code (for short "Cr.P.C.") to quash the proceedings in Crime No.215 of 2020 pending on the file of Chirala II Town Police Station, Prakasam District, registered for the offences punishable under Sections 188, 273,328 of Indian Penal Code (for short "I.P.C."), Sections 24(1) r/w 27 of The Cigarettes And Other Tobacco Products (Prohibition of Advertisement And Regulation Of Trade And Commerce, Production, Supply And Distribution) Act, 2003, and Section 59(i) of Food Safety and Standards Act.

entities.text: Chirala II Town Police Station, Prakasam District
entities.label: ORG

entities.text: Cigarettes And Other Tobacco Products (Prohibition of Advertisement And Regulation Of Trade And Commerce, Production, Supply And Distribution) Act, 2003
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Public Prosecutor for the State of Andhra Pradesh submit that the issue involved in this petition is squarely covered by the order of this Court in Criminal Petition No.3731 of 2018 and batch dated 27.08.2018.

In view of the submission of the learned counsel for the petitioners and the learned Public Prosecutor for the State of Andhra Pradesh, this criminal petition also stands allowed in terms of the said order.
Consequently, miscellaneous applications, pending if any, shall stand closed.
The Registry is directed to attach a copy of the order in Crl.P.No.3731 of 2018 and batch dated 27.08.2018 to this order.

JUSTICE M. SATYANARAYANA MURTHY Date: 22.09.2020 SP Shaik Vadud, vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh, on 22 September, 2020 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/26388023/
